name: resonance_hall
theme: a world of visible sound — a music-box concert hall dives through brass mechanism and sand figures into a lattice of standing waves, folds out to a ringing star, and comes home through the rose window

registers.name: hall
registers.scene: a grand music-box concert hall seen from the empty floor at the back, tiers of gilded balconies curving around a wide stage, rows of brass instruments on their stands, a huge brass gramophone horn at the center of the stage, a great circular stained-glass rose window of teal and gold set high in the wall above, warm lamplight on gilt and dark wood, empty, no one present
registers.target: a huge brass gramophone horn, a wide flared bell chased with engraved scrollwork
registers.loop_target: the grand music-box concert hall, gilded balconies and rows of brass instruments around a wide stage beneath a stained-glass rose window

registers.name: gramophone
registers.scene: a wide flared brass bell, engraved scrollwork chased in spirals across the polished metal, its narrow throat seated in a dark lacquered cabinet whose mechanism stands open below
registers.target: a brass cylinder, dense spiral rows of fine steel pins across its surface

registers.name: cylinder
registers.scene: a brass music-box cylinder, dense spiral rows of fine steel pins studding it in a bright grid, a steel comb of tuned teeth alongside, and beneath the comb a small square brass plate strewn with pale sand
registers.target: a square brass plate strewn with pale sand, the sand gathered into a symmetric star figure

registers.name: chladni_plate
registers.scene: a square brass plate, its polished surface covered in fine pale sand gathered into a symmetric star figure of nodal ridges, sharp points where the ridges meet, bare brass in the open cells between them
registers.target: a grid of luminous cells, bright wave-fronts crossing in pale gold light

registers.name: wave_lattice
registers.palette: pale gold and deep teal light
registers.scene: a lattice of standing-wave light, luminous wave-fronts crossing into a grid of bright and dark cells, pale gold nodes at every crossing on deep teal dark

registers.name: wave_nebula
registers.scene: a vast teal nebula of concentric wave-front shells, great arcs of luminous gas nested one inside the next, dark dust lanes between the shells, stars scattered across the black
registers.target: a bright white star, a hard brilliant sphere wrapped in rings of gold light

registers.name: ringing_star
registers.scene: a blazing white-gold star, its skin a granular mosaic of bright cells, nested concentric shells of gold light wrapped around it, tall arcs of fire standing off the limb
registers.target: a dark teal planet, pale cloud bands drawn in long arcs across its face

registers.name: planet
registers.scene: a dark teal planet seen from space, its curved limb aglow, pale cloud bands drawn in long arcs over an ocean night side, gold light scattered on the dark land
registers.target: a golden city, avenues and squares picked out in warm points of light

registers.name: city
registers.scene: a night city seen from high above, gold-lit avenues in a grid between dark blocks, teal canals threading between them, a great domed concert hall at the center of a wide plaza
registers.target: a domed concert hall, a circular stained-glass rose window of teal and gold

registers.name: hall_facade
registers.scene: the front of a great domed concert hall at night, carved stone piers and brass doors below, a huge circular stained-glass rose window of teal and gold set in the facade above and lit from within, an empty plaza before it, no one present

music_theme: a vast empty concert hall of brass and stained glass, hymnlike and resonant, warm swelling strings over deep bell tones, luminous and reverberant, one bright bloom of sound at the fold out to the stars
